name: (2+1)D CNN Radiance Decoder
definition: A factorized convolutional neural network decoder that applies 2D spatial convolutions followed by 1D depth convolutions to predict the radiance field from the target view frustum volume.
summary: The (2+1)D CNN Radiance Decoder predicts radiance fields using factorized 2D and 1D convolutions, offering 50% fewer parameters than full 3D CNNs while capturing spatial context for efficient novel view synthesis.
